# TEOTIA & CO.

> Chartered accountancy firm in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, providing taxation, audit, corporate finance, and regulatory compliance for Indian and international clients.

TEOTIA & CO. is based at F2, Block-F, Sector-8, Noida, U.P. 201301. Phone +91 8287858780. Email info@teotiaco.com. Areas served: Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi NCR, India, and international clients. Partners include Shubham Teotia (CA), Rahul Chaudhary (CA), Shefali Teotia, Kunal Teotia (CS), and Shaurya Nijhawan (CA).

## Services

- [Company Incorporation & Business Setup](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/company-incorporation): Company, LLP, and OPC registration with statutory approvals for founders and investors in India.
- [Corporate Secretarial Compliance](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/corporate-secretarial): ROC filings, board and shareholder matters, statutory records, and MCA compliance.
- [FDI, FEMA & Cross-Border Advisory](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/fdi-fema-advisory): Foreign investment structuring, FEMA compliance, and cross-border transaction support.
- [Regulatory Approvals & Government Liaison](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/regulatory-approvals): Registrations, licenses, approvals, and regulatory clearances for businesses.
- [M&A and Transaction Advisory](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/ma-transaction-advisory): Due diligence, transaction structuring, and regulatory support for mergers and acquisitions.
- [Contracts & Commercial Agreements](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/contracts-agreements): Drafting, review, and negotiation of contracts and commercial agreements.
- [Startup, MSME & Business Growth Advisory](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/startup-msme-advisory): Advisory for startups and MSMEs covering registration, growth, and compliance.
- [IPR Protection](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/ipr-protection): Trademark, copyright, and patent protection support.
- [Taxation, Accounting & Compliance](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/taxation-accounting): Income tax, GST, TDS, and accounting support.
- [Corporate Restructuring & Due Diligence](https://www.teotiaco.com/services/corporate-restructuring): Restructuring, mergers, demergers, and due diligence.
